compliance.summary: The healthcare promotion presents GoGloby as an AI implementation provider selling a bundled workflow and monitoring system, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency. It also contains unsupported claims about the assessment, security setup, performance targets, and the author.

llm_problems.title: AI implementation company positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity and Services
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as a provider that implements healthcare AI, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the implementation-provider positioning with the approved company description and accurately describe the staffing or recruiting service.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: GoGloby treats healthcare AI adoption as an Applied AI Engineering problem
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby as solving AI implementation problems rather than staffing or recruiting engineers.

locations.quote: GoGloby provides a controlled path to adoption built for quality, security, and measurable performance.
locations.reason: This promises an AI adoption service instead of the company’s documented recruiting and staffing services.

llm_problems.title: Obsolete AI adoption system offer
llm_problems.issue: The page sells a bundled AI implementation system with old product components that GoGloby’s current documents do not offer.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the obsolete system and its components, and describe only the documented recruiting or nearshore staffing offer.

llm.evidence: AI in healthcare applies machine learning and generative models to streamline care workflows and reduce manual effort in clinical and administrative processes. Adoption is accelerating as providers face growing demand and tighter capacity.
llm.note: The opening defines AI in healthcare and describes adoption, but does not answer which use cases, benefits, or examples the H1 promises.
llm.fix: Revise the first two sentences to directly answer the H1 with the article’s key use cases, benefits, and examples.
llm.title: Opening does not answer the H1

llm.note: The article is primarily informational about AI in healthcare rather than a recruiting page.
llm.title: Does not say early that GoGloby is a recruiting firm

llm.evidence: This article breaks down practical AI use cases in healthcare and the metrics that define success in real workflows.
llm.note: The article is aimed at readers learning about healthcare AI use cases, not companies ready to hire Data and AI engineers.
llm.fix: Refocus the article on companies seeking to hire Data and AI engineers and the hiring support they need.
llm.title: Not written for buyers ready to hire
llm.fragment: This article breaks down practical AI
